title: Capability table
description: INTERNAL. Shape of src/adapters/capabilities.json, the static capability table of TECHNICAL-DESIGN 5.6 (ADPT-02). It is not a public format: agents and the app never read this file, they receive the row already resolved (hello.capability_row, protocol/channel/channel.v1.schema.json). The schema exists so that a hand-edited row cannot reach a release with a missing column, a misspelled field or a support level nobody implements.

capabilities_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Bumped only by a change that breaks the readers.

_notes.description: Free-form documentation kept next to the data, in the style of patterns/certain-secrets.v1.json. Never read by code.

rows.description: One row per agent id. The unknown row must be present: it is the fallback of the identity resolution and the source of every null field.

agent_id.description: The table key, shared with the app (channel agent_id) and with the installation adapters (INST-08). Not an enum, so a new adapter does not bump the protocol.

status.description: supported: the adapter has shipped and its facts are measured. planned: the row exists so the agent enters the table in the committed order of ADPT-06, and its unmeasured fields are null.

support.description: The declared support level of ADPT-01.

per_server_timeout_field.description: Name of the per-server timeout field in that agent's MCP entry (A-04), or null when the agent has none or it has not been measured.

session_identity.description: How the app keys a session of this agent. Never null: an agent whose identity strategy is unknown cannot be added to the table.

user_request_delivery.description: How a user-opened request reaches this agent (OPEN-03..08), in the order the app tries them, or null when it has not been measured.

heartbeat_after_ms.description: The heartbeat to use when no tool timeout can be resolved (TOOL-06a). Only the unknown row sets it; every other row inherits it through the null rule.

match.description: What the identity resolution of 5.6 compares against, in its own order: HANDOFF_AGENT against env, then clientInfo.name against client_names.

env.description: The HANDOFF_AGENT value the installer writes for this agent. null on the unknown row, which nothing selects explicitly.

client_names.description: clientInfo.name values observed for this agent (A-08). Empty until the canary suite records them; only measured values belong here.

nullable_boolean.description: null means not measured for this agent; the server reads the unknown row's value instead. It never means false.

nullable_duration_ms.description: A duration in milliseconds, or null when not measured.
